why: Neither must_not item shows up. Checks 1–3 (the behaviour lines) all run the program: `node $CLI` on temp files, stdin via `-`, `- -`, no arguments and a missing file. None of them passes on reading the diff. Their PASS/FAIL conditions match the issue lines. Check 3 only asks for "an error message about the unreadable file" on stderr, not exact wording. No check sets a branch-name rule, a mutation test or a limit on which files the PR may touch. Check 6 fails only if the change is "split over several PRs". The advisory section says outright that rejecting `- -` before reading and the exact usage wording "are not required by the lines". The builder brief's "Rewrite only the CLI" and "e.g." message text are build guidance, not PASS/FAIL conditions. Check 4 reads the diff, but line 4 is not a behaviour line, and it also runs `lint` at head and at base to compare the outputs.
